title: Krummholz bounded public-domain scientific text intake

policy.eligibility: Explicit item-level CC0 or verified U.S. government public-domain text with deployment-jurisdiction review; public access alone is insufficient.
policy.cc_by_disposition: Excluded from this public-domain-only intake; requires a separate approved licensed-data register if policy changes.
policy.third_party_rights: A whole-document metadata label does not clear separately credited components or linked datasets.
policy.personal_data: No private email/client data. Strip personal identifiers and contact blocks; retain necessary bibliographic attribution separately.
policy.legal_scope: This register records evidence and operational gates, not a guarantee of title or legal clearance.

split_policy.unit: Source family, including revisions, translations, shared passages, questions, paraphrases and synthetic derivatives.
split_policy.holdout_use: Dev/test text cannot enter training, synthetic generation for training, prompt tuning or training retrieval stores.
split_policy.inherited_base_overlap: Unknown. These splits measure this adaptation's held-out sources, not proven absence from base-model pretraining.
split_policy.blocked_source: A held source remains absent; do not silently reassign its partition or train on test replacements.

required_before_ingestion: Retrieve exact document and rights evidence; record final URL, retrieval time, SHA256, byte count and edition.
Inspect full text and credits; approve explicit page/section ranges, jurisdiction scope and exclusions.
Extract text with page/section offsets; validate OCR, equations, units and tables against source.
Remove boilerplate, third-party text and personal identifiers; manually inspect flagged and sampled retained text.
Deduplicate exact and near-matching passages across all source groups before freezing partitions.
Record reviewer, filtering version and approved uses; keep approved flags false until all gates pass.
